objective.statement: Name and write notes in the alto clef.
successCriteria: I know the alto clef puts middle C on the middle line.
I can name notes on the lines and spaces of the alto stave.
I can write a named note in the alto clef.

explanation.text: As well as the treble clef (the G clef) and the bass clef (the F clef), there is a third clef: the C clef. It points to the line that is middle C. When the C clef is centred on the middle line of the stave it is called the alto clef, and the middle line is middle C.

music.textAlternative: An alto stave with five semibreves on the five lines: F, A, middle C, E and G.

explanation.caption: The five lines of the alto stave: F, A, C (middle C), E, G.

explanation.text: From middle C on the middle line, count one letter for each line and space. Going up: the space above is D, the next line is E, then F, then G on the top line. Going down: B in the space below, A on the second line, G, then F on the bottom line.

music.textAlternative: An alto stave with nine semibreves from the bottom line up to the top line: F, G, A, B, middle C, D, E, F, G.

explanation.caption: Line, space, line, space ...: F to G, bottom line to top line.

explanation.text: The same notes are written very differently in other clefs. The viola reads the alto clef; it is the only instrument in the modern orchestra that normally does. Remember the anchor: alto clef, middle C on the middle line.
Alto clef: middle C on the middle line. Bottom line F, top line G. Count one letter for each line and space from middle C.

music.textAlternative: An alto stave with middle C on the middle line, then E and G above it.

steps: Find the middle line: that is middle C.
The next line up is E; the top line is G.
Count one letter for every line and space.
demonstration.textAlternative: Middle C on the middle line, then E and G.

guided.prompt: In the alto clef, which line of the stave is middle C?

bottom.reason: Middle C sits below the bass stave's top... in the alto clef the clef sign itself points to middle C: its centre rests on the middle line.

second.reason: The alto clef is centred on the middle line, and the centre of the clef is middle C.

top.reason: The top line of the alto stave is G, a fifth above middle C.

provenance.notes: Original wording. Follows Grade 4 outcome 5 and First Steps Grade 4 section 14 (p. 101): the C clef, the alto clef centred on the middle line, middle C, and the viola. Key signatures in the alto clef are taught in G4-U3-L03 (the planned unit refinement); questions here use no key signature. Instrument fact (viola) is taught here but not credited to the orchestra outcome.
